ONLY ONE FILE METHOD FOR GITHUB APK BUILD

Do not upload the old 82+ files.
Create this exact file path in your GitHub repository:
.github/workflows/build-android-apk.yml

Paste the contents of Klassido-Mail-World_SINGLE_FILE_GitHub_APK_Workflow.yml into that file.
Then go to Actions > Build Klassido Mail World Android APK > Run workflow.
Backend URL: https://mail.klassido.com
